title: A gap on a track looks like an empty slot, dashed and hatched as the mock draws it
goal: After a lift or a trim opens a gap between two clips, the gap is just bare lane today, so it is easy to miss. The cut walkthrough mock draws it as a dashed, softly hatched slot the height of a clip, so a person sees there is a hole to close.
notes: Found while building click-to-pick-a-gap (task a-gap-between-clips-closes-with-a-click-and-dele). Mock: docs/design/mocks/pages/video-cut-wt.html .gap style line 53, #theGap line 297. Gaps per track come from PhotonzDocument.gaps(onTrack:) (Sources/PhotonzCore/TimelineGap.swift); the lane already lays a hit area over each gap in TimelineTrackRows.lane, so the drawing can sit in the same ForEach. Text-free, so no legibility risk.
acceptance: A gap between two clips on a video or audio track is drawn as the mock video-cut-wt step 7 draws #theGap: a dashed outline and diagonal hatch, clip height, rounded like a clip
A picked gap still wears the range band over that drawing, and a Captions track draws no gap
A walk at Next defaults photographs a lifted gap beside the mock frame and the audit lists every difference
